findings.evidence: Dropped behavioural guard. The exact removed candidate group-hover:[--text-color:var(--primary)], compiled from the base revision with the repo's own tailwindcss 4.3.0 and src/app/globals.css, carries @media (hover: hover) (docs/reviews/artifacts/2026-08-11-task691-hover-envelope.css). The replacement .card:hover .cardTitle carries none, and the shipped bundle confirms the sibling is inside @media (hover:hover) while the replacement is not. On coarse-pointer devices the original never applied; the replacement applies on tap and persists. The module header states the opposite. Layer and specificity also changed. No allowedSemanticDeltas cite an owner decision, so every delta is uncited.

.screenshots/task691-delta/capture-computed-styles.mjs pins viewport 1024x4000 at :92 and locale en with only patterns-mantine-listingcardpattern--default at :96. AC10 as written requires both enrolled stories, and the Q3 profile requires four locales and four viewports. Site 229 is additionally a synthetic node that renders in neither story. The rendered matrix cannot substitute for a computed-style capture. Re-run the same script at the missing tuples, or record an owner decision narrowing AC10.

Three homepage-grid transcripts exist (51 FAIL contaminated, 13 FAIL UNATTRIBUTED, 12 FAIL final) but the completion summary states one authorized re-run. Retry classification requires each execution to be recorded separately and forbids relabelling a contaminated run as an authorized retry. The run1 race attribution is itself INFERENCE without an A/B, though grid-not-found across unrelated stories makes it an invalid measurement either way. Correct the summary; no re-work.

leading-snug has never applied on either card title: Mantine's Text sets line-height via --text-lh (measured 20.02px) unlayered, so the @layer utilities copy always lost. Correctly left untouched under AC5's list-and-leave rule, but it is a real latent typography item and needs its own number (746, verified free). A follow-up does not repair this task's status and is recorded here only as residue.

Two orchestrator defects in the kickoff, found by the executor: the route table is 54 rows and the kickoff said 53, and §3.5 named six overlay utilities while a seventh D35-shaped sibling (text-muted-foreground/70) exists. Neither affects the implementation.
